title: Jail world??
content: I had an extremely vivid dream last night where I started in the mall world but somehow ended up in the school, where a friend of mine IRL and I got sent to jail just for the day? Both of our moms were coming to pick us up at 7:30pm so it was just for the day. We had planned to nap majority of the time but the “guard” lady was strict even though there were tv’s. We could sneak phones in under certain stipulations, however my friend got caught with her phone and the lady took it away. It was by far the most vivid dream I’ve had outside of the mall, wondering if anyone had experienced something similar.
